text:
- **Work tracking moved:** Harness work items moved to Yeeef/pm with their identifiers kept, and the old project is closed. The Linux server's clone runs Go pm and syncs with GitHub.
- **Go-only pm:** Python pm is deleted from Yeeef/pm and yeeef-agents. The harness test suite now checks only Go pm. The design pages and docs describe one Go implementation.
- **Release notes:** Each pm release note now comes from its CHANGELOG.md section, with an upgrade guide. CI refuses a pull request or release tag without one.
- **For you:** Review the open pull requests and decide the next release version, since main has a breaking change. Also decide whether an old sprint's docs item moves to a newer sprint.
